title: How the six-language external (Wikipedia) panel is run
status: written before any quantized output on the external panel exists; the main study (freeze.json) and its running jobs are unchanged
panel: freeze_external.json: wikimedia/wikipedia 20231101 revision b04c8d1ceb2f5cd4588862100d08de323dccfbaa, six languages (eng_Latn, spa_Latn, rus_Cyrl, hin_Deva, zho_Hans, yor_Latn), 100 calibration and 300 evaluation passages each, 64 to 128 tokens; the text is only on Ada (CC BY-SA, not in git) and every passage is verified by its sha256 and its token count against the freeze before any model call
E1_group_level: The K64 group and the three matched control draws of each of the six languages (the sets of the groups manifest, unchanged) are ablated on that language's 300 EVALUATION passages (the rank order of the freeze is the sentence index), in the same five cells, states (INT16 rounding reference, INT6, INT4), Grams and A9/A10 scalars as the main group level; analysed with the same functions (languages = the six, 300 sentences, 3 controls): net harm, C, W, I, native difference, the A3 summary with its sentence bootstrap. The calibration passages are not used.
E2_feature_level: All 404 features of the main core (same ids, matched swapped directions, language indices, calibration/held-out split) with contexts chosen by the F5 rule on the 1,800 external EVALUATION passages (all six languages pooled, as the main rule pools the 27 languages): per feature the M = 16 passages with the largest maximum full-precision activation (content positions, BOS excluded) among those where it is positive, ties to the smaller index; a feature with fewer than min_ctx = 4 such passages is excluded and listed. The selection uses only full-precision activations; it is written to core_external.json and its hashes to an amendment file BEFORE the quantized run; the quantized run refuses a core whose hash differs. Same states, directions (real, matched swapped, three random), cells, Grams and scalars as the main feature level. Cluster of an item = its passage (each passage is its own document; no parallel translations), so the bootstrap clusters are passages; the numerical floor and eligibility are fixed from the INT16 CALIBRATION-split features on the external items by the same rule (95th percentile, five times).
E3_analysis: The report driver is run on the external directories with the cluster modulus set to a value above the number of passages (every passage its own cluster) and the languages set to the six; the claim rules of phase1_transfer_report.py are applied unchanged and reported as the external-validity result next to the main one. Additionally the diagnostic is evaluated cross-corpus: the models fitted on the FLORES calibration features (main study) predict the external held-out items (no refit); this is reported as a separate row and is not part of the claim rules.
not_claimed: A replication of the 27-language study: six languages and one corpus family. Chinese Traditional-character filtering of zho_Hans is a heuristic (freeze_external.json).
